items.title: Fred Moore Interview, 1959-06-19
items.q: The first job I had was, Wafwa was a Wilma Sweatman.

ctx.x: Yeah. Oh, when were you with Joe Oliver? That's another thing I wanted to say.
Well, I joined Joe Oliver 1929, right here in New York. Of course, that wasn't the first job I had. The first job I had was, Wafwa was a Wilma Sweatman.
